Vimlesh Vishwakarma vs State Of U.P. on 7 October, 2025

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89258200/
1

 Hon'Ble Sameer Jain, J. 
1.

Sri Deepak Kumar Vishwakrma, learned counsel for applicant, Sri Chandan Kumar Jaiswal,
learned counsel for opposite party no.2 and Sri Manoj Kumar Singh, learned Brief Holder for the
State are present.

2.  The instant transfer application has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to transfer the Session Trial No. 237 of 2019 arising out of Case Crime No. 126 of 2019, under Sections 363, 366,
376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Lalapur, District Prayagraj pending in the court of Additional Session Judge/Special Judge, POCSO Act 1st Prayagraj to Special Judge POCSO Act,
Prayagraj.
3.

entities.text: court of Additional Session Judge/Special Judge, POCSO Act 1st Prayagraj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: At the very outset, learned counsel for applicant submits, applicant does not want to press the instant transfer application, therefore, same may be dismissed as withdrawn.
4. Learned AGA as well as learned counsel for opposite party no.2 are having no objection.
5. In view of above, the instant transfer application stands dismissed as withdrawn.

(Sameer Jain,J.) October 7, 2025 AK Pandey  Vimlesh Vishwakarma vs State Of U.P. on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89258200/
